phases.objective: Separate Local Connector tunnel provisioning authority from the Staging ingress credential, preserve exact Windows runtime ownership, and fail closed with actionable no-secret evidence when Connector-specific credential material is absent.

e2e_journeys.actor: Windows Staging AutoPilot and Local Connector recovery
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The Local Connector is healthy on localhost while connector.mad4b.com is unavailable and no Connector-specific tunnel credential is installed.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Certification records connector_tunnel_provisioning_required without reusing the Staging tunnel token; an explicitly supplied or read-only recovered remotely-managed Connector tunnel token is stored in a protected token file, the canonical Local Connector Cloudflared task uses token-file transport, and the independent Staging Cloudflared runtime remains unchanged.
steps: Bind Git child processes to an explicit filesystem working directory so repository-relative remotes are deterministic under Windows PowerShell.
Normalize legacy optional Auto Deploy state and preserve current child failure evidence without inventing deployment or certification success.
Reject the Staging CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN as a Local Connector provisioning source.
Classify a missing Local Connector token file as connector_tunnel_provisioning_required before attempting a futile tunnel restart.
Accept only Connector-specific token-file/process input or GET-only recovery of an existing remotely-managed Cloudflare tunnel when explicit provider authority is supplied.
Store Connector tunnel material in a restricted token file and keep it out of Scheduled Task arguments and logs.
Run only Mad4B-LocalConnector-Cloudflared for Connector transport and prove Mad4B-Staging-Cloudflared state and PID are unchanged.
Resume exact-SHA Staging certification only after the public Connector health gate becomes healthy.
assertions: Production mutation, DNS mutation, database mutation, schema mutation and grant widening remain false.
The generic Staging CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN is never used as Connector credential fallback.
Device-specific credentials-file paths are not part of the portable Local Connector package.
A locally-managed Cloudflare tunnel is not silently treated as remotely-managed token transport; migration is reported explicitly.
No raw Connector or Cloudflare secret is committed, logged, returned in state evidence, or embedded in Scheduled Task arguments.
Local Connector repair cannot stop, restart, delete or reconfigure Mad4B-Staging-Cloudflared.
Missing provisioning authority blocks certification truthfully instead of collapsing into Cloudflare 1033 after a deterministic failed restart.
